> 第11章 宗门武比（第1页）
随着时间的推移，一个宗门长老站了出来，然后宣布比赛规则，千人之战，分成五个小队。每个小队两百人，五十人站在擂台上的算晋级。胜者再依次轮战，再五人挑战。直到决出武比冠军。冠军两千金币、一颗天神丹、一把上品武器、一本功法。若被长老们看中，还能收为亲传弟子。
第二名，一千金币，一把下品武器。直到决出前三依次轮推。
但是前提有一点，可以认输，不得下杀手。谁若违规，直接按宗规处置。
只见长老伸手一挥，五个战台出现。每两百人。
李天和林耀也走向一个擂台。别人都是五十人抱团，而李天则是和林耀两人抱团。这瞬间成了鲜明的对比，遭到针对。另一个团队则少了两人，领头的立马看向他们俩，
邀请道；两位兄弟可以和我们组队吗？
而李天则说不用，我们自己就是一个队，先让他们争，我们看着就好。
听着李天和林耀的对话，几方领头的当场就不乐意了，我说对面兄弟。要不先把这两人打下去，我们在争夺名额。
对面一听，少两个人就少两个人，只要先把这两个人弄下去，让他们没机会。
而李天有把握的是，对面三个化凡境后期。自己有把握全胜，也就没有必要组队，最主要是没有田萧在这队，不然非得再次让它有个难忘的今生。
只见双方同意然后把两人围在中间，
顿时和他们大战了起来，只见五个战台都是人影横飞，掉落战台外。有的觉得可惜，又要错过一次晋升的机会。
而李天这边两人同时释放境界气息，随着气息出来，台下台上都惊呼出声。
化凡初期，妖孽一样的天才。是不是一直扮猪吃老虎？
现在的吸引力都被三号战台吸引住，主要是李天化凡初期竟然能战化凡后期的人。打的有来有回，而且还护着一个炼体九重的人。特别是那些化凡以下的根本不是他一合之将，就全部飞出台下。这样的战斗力堪称妖孽。而随着人数越来越少。最终一个化凡后期的偷袭李天，被李天一拳砸下擂台。重伤。肋骨断了几根。根本爬不起来。
不一会儿？所有战台结束，每个擂台站着五十人，有的拼着受伤战到了最后。
主持的长老开口道，休息时间两个小时。众人终于松了口气，以为要连续战斗，那不是要淘汰很多人。两个小时足够他们疗伤了，甚至恢复巅峰状态。
而林耀却受了一些伤，要不是身边有李天帮忙着，自己也会是擂台下的一员。

李天则是一点伤没受。还磨砺了自己的功法，实战才是检验战力的最好标准。
随着时间的推移，两个小时很快过去。人们纷纷上擂台，还是自由选择，而这次田萧和田战选择了李天阵营。

The latest chapter of The Great Emperor - Chapter 11: Sect Martial Competition Page 1 - How long can the Great Emperor go in the future - Hot Novel Website
> Chapter 11 Sect Martial Arts Competition (Page 1)
As time went by, a sect elder stood up and announced the rules of the game, a battle of thousands of people, divided into five teams. There are two hundred people in each team, and those with fifty people standing in the ring will advance. The winners will then take turns to fight, and then five people will challenge. Until the martial arts champion is determined. The champion gets two thousand gold coins, a god pill, a top-grade weapon, and a book of exercises. If you are favored by the elders, you can even be accepted as a direct disciple.
Second place, one thousand gold coins, and a low-grade weapon. Until the top three are determined, they will be pushed in turn.
But there is one premise: you can admit defeat, but you are not allowed to kill. Anyone who violates the rules will be dealt with directly according to the clan rules.
The elder waved his hand and five battle platforms appeared. Every two hundred people.
Li Tian and Lin Yao also walked towards a ring. Others were in a group of fifty people, but Li Tian and Lin Yao were in a group. This moment became a sharp contrast and was targeted. The other team was missing two people, and the leader immediately looked at them.
Invitation: Can the two brothers form a team with us?
But Li Tian said no, we are a team ourselves, let them fight first, and we can just watch.
Listening to the conversation between Li Tian and Lin Yao, the leaders of several parties were unhappy on the spot. I said to the brother on the other side. How about knocking these two down first? We are competing for spots.
The other side heard that if two people were missing, they would be missing two people. They just had to get rid of these two people first so that they had no chance.
What Li Tian is sure of is that the three opponents are in the late stage of Mortal Realm. Since he was sure of victory, there was no need to form a team. The most important thing was that Tian Xiao was not on the team, otherwise he would have to give it an unforgettable life again.
I saw that both parties agreed and then surrounded the two people.
A battle broke out with them immediately, and figures were seen flying across the five battle platforms and falling outside the battle platforms. Some feel it is a pity that they have to miss another opportunity for promotion.
On Li Tian's side, the two people released their realm aura at the same time. As the aura came out, everyone on and off the stage exclaimed in surprise.
In the early stage of his mortal transformation, he was a genius like a monster. Have you been pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger?
The current attraction is attracted by the No. 3 battle platform, mainly because Li Tian can actually fight against people in the late stage of transforming into a mortal. He was beaten back and forth, and he was also protecting a person who was at the ninth level of body refining. Especially those who were below the mortal level were not his generals at all, and they all flew off the stage. Such fighting power can be called a monster. And as the number of people gets smaller and smaller. In the end, a late stage mortal attacker attacked Li Tian and was knocked off the ring with a punch from Li Tian. seriously injured. Several ribs were broken. Couldn't get up at all.
Soon? After all the fighting stages were over, there were fifty people standing in each stage, some of whom fought to the end with injuries.
The presiding elder said, "The rest time is two hours." Everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that if they were to fight continuously, they wouldn't have to eliminate many people. Two hours is enough for them to heal and even return to their peak condition.
But Lin Yao suffered some injuries. If Li Tian hadn't been helping him, he would have been a member of the group under the ring.
Li Tianze was not injured at all. He also sharpened his skills. Actual combat is the best criterion for testing his combat power.
As time went by, two hours passed quickly. People came to the ring one after another, still free to choose, and this time Tian Xiao and Tian Zhan chose the Li Tian camp.
